---
title: LLM Integration
---

SearcherKit separates model transport from model format. The LLM client talks
to a provider or inference server; the parser translates messages and tool
calls between that provider-facing representation and SearcherKit's internal
message types.

### Request and response path

```bash
SearchAgent history
    -> Parser.to_model()
    -> Client.complete_with_usage()
    -> provider response
    -> Parser.from_model()
    -> assistant and tool-call messages
```

This split matters when two models use the same OpenAI-compatible endpoint but
different chat templates or textual tool-call formats. Change the parser when
the format changes; change the client when API transport changes.

### Built-in clients

| `type` | Use case |
| --- | --- |
| `openai` | OpenAI and OpenAI-compatible chat completion endpoints |
| `anthropic` | Anthropic-compatible message endpoints |

```yaml
agent:
  llm_client:
    type: openai
    model: Qwen3-8B
    api_key: ${oc.env:LLM_API_KEY,EMPTY}
    base_url: ${oc.env:LLM_BASE_URL,http://127.0.0.1:8001/v1}
    concurrency_limit: 128
    default_kwargs:
      temperature: 0.6
      top_p: 0.95
      max_completion_tokens: 8192
```

`default_kwargs` are included in each generation request. Keep provider-only
options here rather than teaching the parser about HTTP payload details.

`base_url` may also be a list of compatible endpoints. SearcherKit keeps a
session on one endpoint to improve cache locality; all listed endpoints must
serve the same model and generation contract.

### Built-in parsers

| `type` | Use case |
| --- | --- |
| `upstream` | Provider-native tool calls |
| `tongyi_deep_research` | Tongyi DeepResearch textual tool-call format |
| `webexplorer` | WebExplorer prompt and response format |
| `websailor` | WebSailor prompt and response format |

```yaml
agent:
  parser:
    type: upstream
```

Use `upstream` when the inference server parses model tool-call text and returns
structured provider tool calls.

::: {.callout-tip}
For vLLM or SGLang deployments, configure the
server's tool-call and reasoning parsers to match the model template.
:::

### Streaming

Interactive execution enables `stream_llm` and consumes client stream chunks.

### Retry boundaries

Configure retry for failures that can succeed on another attempt, such as
temporary provider failures or a nondeterministic `ParsingError`:

```yaml
agent:
  llm_retry_config:
    max_tries: 5
    max_time: 3600
    exceptions:
      - pkg://searcherkit.llm.parsers:ParsingError
```

To implement a new transport or model format, see
[Custom Modules](05-customized-modules.qmd).
